title: fix-lp-libp11-provider-autopkgtest → ubuntu/devel
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index a41edc0..91221e5 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+libp11 (0.4.20-1ubuntu2) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * Fix provider autopkgtest with OpenSSL 4.0.3 (LP: #2169584).
+      Select an empty X.509 extensions section when signing, so OpenSSL
+      does not parse provider settings as certificate extensions.
+
+ -- Ravi Kant Sharma <ravi.kant.sharma@canonical.com>  Mon, 05 Oct 2026 12:15:57 +0200
+
 libp11 (0.4.20-1ubuntu1) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   * Merge with Debian unstable (LP: #2163543). Remaining changes:
diff --git a/debian/tests/provider b/debian/tests/provider
index d2ecb00..06da7c1 100755
--- a/debian/tests/provider
+++ b/debian/tests/provider
@@ -29,6 +29,7 @@ trap cleanup EXIT
 cat > ${ssl_cnf} <<EOF
 HOME = .
 openssl_conf = openssl_init
+extensions = test_extensions
 
 [openssl_init]
 providers = provider_sect
@@ -45,6 +46,8 @@ identity = pkcs11prov
 module = /usr/lib/${DEB_BUILD_MULTIARCH}/ossl-modules/pkcs11prov.so
 pkcs11_module = /usr/lib/${DEB_BUILD_MULTIARCH}/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
 activate = 1
+
+[test_extensions]
 EOF
 
 echo "Initializing softhsm2"
